[Mirko Di Natale] https://t.me/GJustjuve/73661🆙🕵🏻‍♂ In recent weeks, there has been a contact with the talent scout #Fratini. #Juventus is evaluating taking on multiple names to reinforce the scouting department and his profile is advancing. The bianconeri could have taken him as a second-choice behind #Vicario. We will see if next summer #Juventus will confirm its interest".[Mirko Di Natale]

LIFE IN ITALY AND FUTURE GOALSOff the pitch, Justin talks about his interests: “I like playing a bit of PlayStation; I’m quite good at EAFC. I listen to music and follow basketball a bit because my sister plays. Turin is a beautiful city with a rich history. It’s lovely to stroll around the city centre; I really enjoy being here.”To conclude, he looks to the present and towards the great achievements of the future: “My main aim for the season is to make an impact in as many matches as possible with the Next Gen side, to score, provide assists, put in good performances and help the team in both phases of play to win matches, whilst always ensuring I’m ready should the manager decide to call m

DEVELOPING WITH THE NEXT GEN PROGRAMME AND HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH COACH BRAMBILLAHis day-to-day work with Juventus’s reserve team remains the main driving force behind his development: “The Next Gen programme is excellent because you play against adults every week, whereas in England reserve teams play against other reserve teams.Playing in the league every week against experienced professionals helps you develop and ensures you’re ready for any future challenge. I have an excellent relationship with Coach Brambilla and the staff, based on honesty: they demand a lot from me because they know what I can offer the team and want me to show my qualities in every training session and every match.

The first player in the spotlight is Next Gen striker Justin Oboavwoduo, born in 2006, who recently made his debut for the First Team in Serie A. ℹ️🔙 Today 10 out of 12 international players will be back, while Nico #González and #Lucumí will return tomorrow. #Alajbegović is still to be evaluated: he will be examined by the bianconero medical staff, but the hope is to have him available for #Cagliari. #Yildiz, #Thuram, #Locatelli, #Grabara, #Ekhator and #Boga remain out, whereas #Cambiaso has returned and #Cabal will try to push for a call-up for Sunday.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇧🇦❗️#Alajbegović suffered a mild muscular discomfort during his international duties with Bosnia. Today, examinations will be conducted to understand the extent of the issue and verify any potential presence of a lesion. For now, he is not in doubt for #Cagliari and, even in case of a negative outcome, #Spalletti might choose not to risk him and preserve him for the Europa League.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
